# BSD Router Project

> BSD Router Project (BSDRP) is an embedded, free and open-source router
> distribution based on FreeBSD, with FRRouting and Bird. It targets
> small-to-large networks and runs on x86_64 (amd64) and arm64 (aarch64),
> requiring 4 GB of storage and 1 GB of RAM.

## About

- [Home](https://bsdrp.net/): project overview and latest release news
- [Features](https://bsdrp.net/features/): routing, VPN, QoS, multi-tenant, monitoring
- [Downloads](https://bsdrp.net/downloads/): images and how to write them
- [License](https://bsdrp.net/license/): BSD 2-clause
- [Contributors](https://bsdrp.net/contributors/)
